summary: Zhibao Technology Inc., a Chinese foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, reporting a wholesale C-suite and board overhaul. The board accepted resignations of multiple directors, the CEO (Mr. Botao Ma, who remains a director but steps down as Chair), and the CFO (Mr. Guangtong Ren), effective immediately, with no disagreements cited. Concurrently, the board appointed Ms. Jinmei Guo Hellstroem as CEO and Chair, Ms. Jinyang Gu as CFO, and three new independent directors, including an audit committee financial expert. This abrupt simultaneous turnover—board, CEO, and CFO—constitutes a management change event, though the filing asserts amicable departures. Watch for subsequent filings clarifying strategic direction or potential listing compliance under Nasdaq rules.
